notes.title: Prison Survival Playtests Has Begun!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Prisoners!

[/p][h2]We're excited to announce that playtests for Prison Survival are now live![/h2][p]
[/p][h2]You can join starting today, July 24, until August 7.[/h2][p]
To join the playtest, simply visit our Prison Survival's Steam page and click “Request Access” - access will be granted automatically.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983910/"][/dynamiclink]

[/p][h1] 🔥What is in this playtest? [/h1][p]
Prison Survival is a first-person prison stealth-action game set in a semi-open prison environment. 
You’re free to explore – but some areas are off-limits. 
Enter a Restricted Area, and guards or security cameras will be on your tail. 
If they catch you – you're sent back to a checkpoint.

You can run, hide, or use parkour to escape – climb pipes, ledges, or sneak through ventilation shafts. You can also fight other inmates with your fists!

The art style is slightly stylized, but we’re keeping the gritty prison atmosphere: gangs, drugs, fights, foul language, and the daily grind of prison life!

[/p][previewyoutube="wKjJcNnzYjo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

[/p][h1]🔥 What is your goal in Prison Survial Playtest?[/h1][p]
You work for a prison boss. Your job? Smuggle contraband – drugs, weapons, and other illegal items.
Pick up orders, avoid or take down guards, use parkour, disable cameras, fight rival inmates, deliver the goods and get back to your cell and go to sleep ;)

You can also buy helpful tools (like lockpicks, remote camera disablers, or a map), or train parkour in a dedicated area!

[/p][h1]📢 Join Our Community![/h1][p]
Visit our Discord for FAQ, control explanations, and to grab the press kit !

[/p][h1]📋Deliver your message![/h1][p]
[h2]Press F5 during a game to report a bug or a suggestion![/h2]
We need your feedback! Help us and become a part of Prison Survival!

[url="https://forms.gle/RXwp2LSzGxxhcviL9" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff8000"]CLICK HERE TO FILL A QUESTIONNAIRE ![/url]

[h1] 👀Invite your friends![/h1]
Once you gain access to the playtest, you’ll be able to use Steam’s new feature to bring your friends… straight to prison 😉 Don't hesitate to invite your firends to Prison Survival Playtest!

------------------
Take care, inmates!
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Last Man Standing mode, sequel and daily deal!
notes.content:
Greetings, Players and Officers! Exciting news awaits you!

We are here to showcase the latest addition to our game, [i]Prison Simulator[/i] - a brand new mode ! And the best part? It will be available for free and is [b]available now![/b] ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/76c22df7656807238489cbb0623129ece6ebbe58.png[/img]

[h2]Daily Deal! - get Prison Simulator on the biggest discout ever![/h2]

These are not all surprises!
In addition to the free add-on and the daily deal, we are creating a sequel to [i]Prison Simulator [/i]for you, in which you will play the role of a prisoner!
See it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983910/Prison_Survival_Architect_of_Crime_Simulator/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/1b9a13d5ee68eafef5d76a575f884120682d4a0f.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Last Man Standing - what are the rules?[/b][/h1]

Introducing [i]Last Man Standing [/i]- an adrenaline-fueled experience where your primary objective is to escape the prison alive! Brace yourself as a riot wreaks havoc within the prison facility. In an unexpected twist, you, as a guard, must find a way to break free. Quite the ironic situation, isn't it? ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/97843b0c3248075f4a2d63364312878868e6375e.gif[/img]

This mode takes a more action-oriented approach, inspired by the immensely popular Riot Event in the full game. We've amplified the action to reach the players who crave intense gameplay within the prison walls.

[h1][b]Getting started[/b][/h1]

Getting started in [i]Last Man Standing[/i] is no cakewalk. You'll begin in a modest office, stripped of weapons or tools. Armed only with your trusty fists, you must fight your way out. Diplomacy won't be of any use this time; the prisoners are furious and thirst for your blood!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4e2fc1ccd08d3874ff32f82b8cf22279411c9db2.png[/img]

[h1][b]Gear up![/b][/h1]

Unleash your fists and engage in combat! Remember to defend yourself by right-clicking to block incoming attacks, but keep a keen eye on your stamina bar.

Thankfully, amidst the chaos and riot, you can scavenge useful items to aid your escape. A riot gun will be indispensable; trust me, you won't want to navigate this mode without it!

Beware of the stronger enemies we've introduced in recent updates to the Riot Event. They've returned for more! Stay on guard against mini-bosses with stolen body armor and weapons! (they can sometimes even have firearms!) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/14c31b852f600897d6b5a223a7cb25f7ffe99c18.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Entirely new prison![/b][/h1]

Prepare to be captivated by an entirely new prison we've crafted for this mode. We had a blast designing it! Once you've escaped (or unfortunately met your demise), a pop-up will display your performance score, including time taken and prisoners neutralized. Strive for the highest score and aim for greatness! (Three difficulty mods available!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4768ae54be6d512a6500c84b19b06412de24be9b.gif[/img]

Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to see you in action within the thrilling world of [i]Prison Simulator![/i]


Best regards,
Baked Games Team

New trailer for Prison Simulator VR has been released!

[i]Prison Simulator VR [/i]is being developed with the help of our friends at [b]Gameboom VR [/b]!
They are a experienced studio with many VR titles on their account! (like Thief Simulator VR)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ae3afbf051047656a2e71c377d895e56b8551520.png[/img]

[h2]Prison Simulator VR - details[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a13500e3dc520b2f44b0da30304082e34e04a6f5.png[/img]

A classic [i]Prison Simulator[/i] experience... but now in [b]VR [/b]:D
More immersive than ever :D
Get a taste of prison life! Become a prison guard and deal with dangerous convicts. 
Prison management, lots of daily activities. Will you become the best guard in history? 
Or maybe you'll turn into the worst scumbag this Prison has ever seen? 
The decision is up to [b]you![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/5a53beca7bc9bb30a4a07d93b816711cb301c3f7.png[/img]

VR version is not a simple port - many mechanics must be reworked from scratch,

[i]Prison Simulator VR [/i]will be available on [i]PCVR headsets, PlayStation VR2, Meta Quest 2, Pico Neo 3, and Pico 4. [/i]
We support seated and standing gameplay. 
The title will be translated into around 10 languages like the main game (for example English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, and Portuguese). 
There will also be support for achievements ;).

notes.title: We are celebrating! - Prison Simulator is now 1 year old!
notes.content:
[h1]Officers! Welcome! We have an important message![/h1]


Hello there dear Players!
Our hit game - [b]Prison Simulator [/b]came out in [b]November 4th 2021[/b] so you know what that mean? 
[b]That Prison Simulator is 1 year old !!![/b]

Boy it was quite a ride! Delivering such funny and entertaining simulator for players!
We are very happy that Prison Simulator bringing joy for Players on all world ;)
We are still working on some updates for it!

In the year after release we updated our game a few times -[b] let's check everything what we was working on! [/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/bd8262a30f176dd7ba9ba0a07bb0db4a4d0b0698.png[/img]

[h2]New skins![/h2]
We added some cool skins for prisoners! You can change their appearance in warden’s PC !
I like the “classic prisoner” skin the most ! ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ab1faa6c866496f224a2a9e383fe95829bc019d7.png[/img]
“Classic Prisoner” skin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d765d204d81c3c50d5366820c538bb05009bfcc6.jpg[/img]
”Slavic outfit” skin 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d765d204d81c3c50d5366820c538bb05009bfcc6.jpg[/img]
„Octopus game” skins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9709313fdb026025b31c6b83386427c9ea9d42ea.png[/img]

[h2]New Twitch mode!![/h2]
Something for streamers!
Set it up in options, start streaming on twitch.tv and see how it comes out!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/bec5e709196ec9fad8ba41a3f2a596c5c7ebe803.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/95420d1a7dc3f0057599427f355cb2b6eaa58acd.gif[/img]
How it works? After certain guard’s routine starts, viewers can vote in chat with commands for some events to start! Like prisoner attacking player or putting something on fire !
Various routines have different possible commands! Check it out!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/5a18673a6ca92e9543488a1e70f121fac9440334.gif[/img]

When voting is over the command will execute in game! It’s a new funny way to integrate with community!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/5360e7f8d024a4ca1ebd0d9b806c09427b355014.gif[/img]

[h2]Three new routines ![/h2]

[b]Laundry [/b]– do the cleaning to show them who is the boss ! 😉 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/01c5429500fd77956b3e0eeb564c0dc73f655c8e.gif[/img]

[b]Nightshift routine [/b]- Be ready to visit your beloved work place at night! A prison at night can be sp00ky and something weird can happen :o
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8be66feefb8e18352fa09542645a003c8b4d2783.gif[/img]

[b]TV Room routine [/b]-  Select some prisoners you want to give some chill time in
social room with TV! Choose carefully because some inmates don't like each other and they can cause some destruction !
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/88245e3caab244ab1fd34c688d6bb2c2e5a547e5.gif[/img]
[h2]
Improved riot event![/h2]
New things can happen in riot so be careful! But you will also receive a new weapons like shotgun!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a3a6e63bf59496a397bd33ed54f06c18d052578b.gif[/img]

[b]Dangerous prisoners [/b]with stolen weapons and guns can also appear on riot! 
There are like some kind of  mini-bosses!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a6d649b35cb6ba3e52a63179ebaa547d3a7935da.gif[/img]

[h2]Steam Deck and gamepad support![/h2]
[b]Prison Simulator[/b] is also now fully compatible on [u]Steam Deck [/u]!
Also we added gamepad support for more comfortable playing!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6f4689a479dfbba035ed2e1495802f4ddb82e6d2.png[/img]

[h2]New update available soon![/h2]
And that’s not all! We are still working on the game new features and on new [b]“Last Man Standing” [/b]mode where you must escape from new prison before rioting prisoners get you ! More info about this new mode in previous devlogs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8d3748c84f82d4a96bb0aaf54802da9b6f567ac2.gif[/img]

[h2]Youtubers and influencers support![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/83b5fd5f53c1ad1a89c9d9408a32a10ddea96aff.gif[/img]

Our game is quite popular on Youtube ;)
Here you can see a short GIF with [b]Markiplier[/b] but there was a looot of others and we 
wanna thank all creators for making such funny videos from our game :D
It the best feeling for every dev - to see that your work bring some people some joy !

[h2]Brand new game about prison riots![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e50a36de1866fbc6042cb505f6c7d23f9bff0892.gif[/img]

We are also started developing a new game concentrating about riots in various prisons!
4 player coop action! Check it out !

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874980/Ready_for_Riot/

[h3]Thank you for reading and thank you very much for playing our game!!! 
Be ready for a new chapter in Prison Simulator game! [/h3]

notes.title: Try out demo of our new game - Plow the Snow !
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello officers![/h1][/b]

We got special announcement for you!
We wanna invite you - [b]Players [/b]to check out a demo for a new game that we are developing!
This game is called [i]Plow the Snow![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c1d67ad0b06f2c99e712213c149b3100db3b3f16.png[/img]

What is it game about? It is a [b]simulator[/b] and [b]casual relaxing[/b] game with a bit cartoony stylized graphic centered around getting rid of the snow in various places !
Help your clients and neighbors get through this winter season. 
You can use multiple machines and brave any obstacle in your path to make the sidewalks and streets free from the snowflake menace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0231325a478a41b61da6d57cded1bef56bbd869f.gif[/img]

[h3]What can you expect in demo version? 
[/h3]

[h3]-Two different levels + garage !

notes.title: Last Man Standing - details about new free mode in Prison Simulator!
notes.content:
[h1]Players and Officers! New important informations ![/h1]

Hello and welcome to the devlog about our new mode we are adding in Prison Simualtor!!
We are working now on several things right now and oneof it is a absolutely [b]new[/b] mode in Prison Simulator! This new mode will be distributed [b]for free[/b] ! 

[h2]Last Man Standing - what are the rules?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4768ae54be6d512a6500c84b19b06412de24be9b.gif[/img]

The rules is simple - get out of prison alive !! The vile riot is destroying prison facility. You have no other choice but to escape ! (it's funny that the guard must escape prison, right?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/97843b0c3248075f4a2d63364312878868e6375e.gif[/img]

This mode is actually action-oriented. We know that you liked a Riot Event from full game a lot ;) so we added some more action in prison for fans ;)

[h2]Getting started[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c4838c3406dbde0b3bfdbaafe439a55f6585f700.gif[/img]

First you will find yourself without weapons or items in small office...  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/dbf8530693e68a355ec8a6be395dd607d943654c.gif[/img]

You got only your trusty fists! Fight your way out! Persuading won't help you this time - prisoners are mad and wants your blood!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/14c31b852f600897d6b5a223a7cb25f7ffe99c18.gif[/img]

Use fists to fight! Remember you can press RMB to defend yourself. But watch a [b]stamina bar[/b] !!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/bc142de2c3a6ebf5cd4ee2812c46086ef76218f7.gif[/img]

Also you can HOLD an attack button to charge a powerfull PUNCH ! No one can resist that !

[h2]This is where a fun begins![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7d14e81c23e2edf8b54ed8172869e3933615a493.gif[/img]

Fortunately in this mess and riot you can still find some usefull items. A riot gun is mandatory, i haven't finished this mode without it ever once :D  
And don't worry about prisoners health - it works on non-lethal bullets !

[h2]Stronger enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b34e4a92cfa13fb1f0888ef1f26c924d3d9cfd09.gif[/img]

In one of the updates we added some stronger prisoners to Riot Event. 
Unfortunately they came back for more!! Watch out for mini-bosses with stolen body armor and weapons and also for a tricky ones with GUNS!! Most dangerous ones! You have to defeat them in order to progress through some rooms

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/34cfd1c505fc0b8beae4021e2d3b421d89fa51d9.gif[/img]

[h2]Entarily new prison![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/45d99ce905fb10090f67e57d06e3322c01866328.gif[/img]

We made a entairly new prison for this mode ! It was fun making it ! Hope you won't get lost ;)
After escaping (or after death) you will get a pop up with some informations of how well did you 
did. You know: time passed, prisoners neutralized etc. Try to aim for the best score!

I hope this mode will get you some challenge and fun! It's [b]almost[/b] ready to be published, please be patient and wait for some more info about future of Prison Simulator - you won't be dissapointed ;)


Watch our social medias especially [url=https://twitter.com/Baked_Games]Twitter[/url] and join our Discord for more behind the scenes footage ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/842180/Prison_Simulator/


Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: New update for Prison Simulator is on the way!

[h1]Welcome Players and Officers![/h1]

How are you guys? 
We gladly announce that [b]another [/b]  update for Prison Simulator is on the way!

What will be in this update? 
Besides some standard bug fixes and some improvements to the gameplay we will [b]add completly new game mode [/b] !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/063310d8fca242336a88a79a59a136693a19c5b2.jpg[/img]

A completly new separate game mode - [b]Last Man Standing [/b]- the player is alone in a new prison which is a set of rooms and corridors. 
This prison is undergoing a huge rebellion - chaos reigns around! 
The player must get out of prison in one piece.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/edecb53d3fdb164c363e92309c1b5f7c9d52e491.gif[/img]

notes.content:
[h1]Welcome Players and Officers[/h1]


Time has come! We gladly introduce you a big FREE update to [b]Prison Simulator![/b]
We were working hard to fix all bugs that you were reporting and also we added some most demanded stuff like new routinies and activities!
So... Are you ready ?
What can you expect in this update?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ba79442baa3582ebc63928bb3af1ffc760943a93.png[/img]


[h1]THREE NEW ROUTINES[/h1]

[h2]Nightshift [/h2]
Be ready for some thrilling actions at prison [b]at night[/b]! Well maybe not so many action but a lot can happen during night. Maybe even someone will try to [b]break out [/b]of prison? And what if you spot a ghost? Spooky!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8be66feefb8e18352fa09542645a003c8b4d2783.gif[/img]

[h2]TV Room [/h2]
Never ever seen before new routine! Select some prisoners you want to give some chill time in
social room with TV! Choose carefuly because some inamtes don't like each other and also every time you select team for [b]TV Room[/b] they respect towards you is increased!
Just look at them how cool and chill they are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/88245e3caab244ab1fd34c688d6bb2c2e5a547e5.gif[/img]

[h2]Laundry[/h2]
Newcomers always get a worst work... Use new opened place in showers to do some laundry! But remember to carefully check other guards uniforms in search of some [b]illegal contrabanda[/b]! Sometimes even officers cannot be trusted! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/931cac841b9cc64afa87faec311e963eccb0073e.gif[/img]


[h2]MUCH IMPROVED RIOT[/h2]

Be [b]ready for riot[/b]! Now riot can happen at night! Use your trusted flashlight to get some advantage over prisoners but... [b]Prisoners are now even stronger[/b]! They can steal some guns from shooting range and use them properly! It's good that these guns are using only rubber bullets... Also some inmates will appear in [b]stolen riot-control armor[/b]! Gonna use some new toys to deal with these [b]mini-bosses[/b]! Thankfuly now you can use new weapons like[b] shotgun[/b] or [b]machine gun[/b]! Come and get some! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9aed07ed5a420da39cf7471270c2420be8724e70.gif[/img]

And of course some [b]bug fixes[/b] and stability issues was fixed.
We are very proud of this update and can't wait to bring you more ;) 
Stay tunned for more info!
Also don't forget that you can grab our game at nice [b]-20% discount[/b] right now! 
It's a great way to start a game: [b]free update+discount[/b] - don't you think ? ;)

notes.title: Big update coming by! Part 3 - NIGHTSHIFT routine -
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there dear players![/h1]


How was your holidays and New Year Eve? Mine was fine but now it's time to do some stuff!
Remember, we are preparing a really big update for you !
Be ready for [b]the end of January[/b] to receive new cool stuff in your favourite Prison Simulator game!
What will be in this update? Check out below and also feel free to check past devlogs on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ba79442baa3582ebc63928bb3af1ffc760943a93.png[/img]

[h2]ABSOLUTELY NEW ROUTINE! NIGHTSHIFT[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/339063358f29df0db0b1c078372994c714886926.gif[/img]

Be ready to visit your beloved work place at night!
It was a popular player's demand to add some new routines and we thought that visting a prison at night can be cool and creepy. Just look at this slow walk, these shady lights, creepy old corridor and a ghoulish ghosts cries? Brrr... Maybe next time i should take a day shift.

[h1]Nightshift in Prison Simulator: what are your responsibilites?[/h1]

[h3]Take a walk[/h3]
At night a lot can happen so be on your guard!
There are some basic stuff like go around and mark a suspicious things like cracks in the walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c9b4116855e3a95be7572684e2eeae1afe4987ff.gif[/img]

[h3]New hiding places[/h3]
Now you can search for contrabanda some new things like tables in canteen room.
Damned inmates! Why they are wanna hide some things here!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/822a8b530d2a64b17c29dbe1e5756cefdfe42191.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/822a8b530d2a64b17c29dbe1e5756cefdfe42191.gif[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/1800cc3470b50aa06982ff40a034e44ac767a8f4.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/1800cc3470b50aa06982ff40a034e44ac767a8f4.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Visit some old friends[/h3]
Gonna check block B for any suspicious behavior.
Luckily there is a least one additional guard so he can help if anything happen...
Most of prisoners just sleep at night. Most of them...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8be66feefb8e18352fa09542645a003c8b4d2783.gif[/img]

[h3]Catch wandering inmates![/h3]
Whoa what is this? How did you escaped your cell and what are you doing here?! Well, no time to explain come with me to the isolation ward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/79c5d48378368932c2402876d83aa32cdedb11b1.gif[/img]

[h3]Put the fire out![/h3]

Aaaah! What now!? A fire?! At least i can see it clearly at night. I think someone has helped this fire to lit but no evidence yet... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/1dbb8aba11e6140b8a136b225eac2e8e4ac0ac9d.gif[/img]

[h3]Enjoy the view[/h3]

So what you think about this new routine? 
It have some atmosphere, right? Maybe we should do a horror game next... Like escape from haunted prison. Hey that's a nice idea actually!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ba1614fc0a75c00f0fe035dcf6fe1da203474faf.gif[/img]


That's all for today. Be ready for some next Devlogs soon and for BIG update at the end of January.
Also you have a chance to get a Prison Simulator with 15% discount at this moment! Be quick because Steam Winter Sale ends soon!

notes.title: Inside the Gameplay: Even more Prison Guard Daily Routines PART 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/72cb15d6d04da37a3c9064bab29abc6037a0ff3a.jpg[/img]
I hope you're ready to learn what else awaits you in the full version of Prison Simulator.
The game launches on November 4th exclusively on Steam.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0d7891c4ddfb1bd6e0591a68a0a7105938725704.jpg[/img]
[h1]Workshop[/h1]
While in Prison, all inmates have is time. So why not make them more productive and earn some cash for the Prison? So each day bunch of inmates works shifts in the workshop. 

Your role is to pick the perfect guys for the tasks. (If you screw this up and select the members of rival gangs, they will beat the shit out of each other). 
Assign them to their stations and make sure that all of them actually work. 

But you know how it is. Accidents happen, and someone might get hurt; there are times when they might misuse the blowtorch (def not by accident), and you'll need to search for your inner firefighter. 

But you can always decide to make your prisoners work overtime to work off the damage. The decision is yours.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d5805d37c8a067212f9e4e6de2f400a7d033ca89.jpg[/img]
[h1]Searching packages[/h1]
Drugs, tools, weapons. You won't believe what these convicts will get in their packages. And their close ones tend to be very creative in smuggling prohibited items. So your job is to search through all the boxes. 
If you overlook anything - your fellow prison guards will lose respect for ya. Things might get ugly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b7d160008303a5f9024607bac6c18b3a7c4d7642.jpg[/img]
[h1]Visiting Room[/h1]

Family and friends visiting the Prisoners is their only occasion to have contact with the outside world. But you know – Prison is the place where Convicts should obey rules. And one rule about having guests is that – you cannot spend there all day. Your job is to make sure that the visit is not too long and that you keep your inmates' emotions in check. (yup, especially those negative ones)
 
But you know – as a Prison Guard, you have a choice. You can let someone sit a bit longer (for a bribe ofc), but it may come with a price. Of what kind? You can check for yourself.
 
Did I mention that this Prison also has a special room for more "intimate encounters"? 😉
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6ea28a45390a7c220a2af1a516f5ea33b04f0f36.jpg[/img]
[h1]Monitoring[/h1]

Observe your Inmates and check if they're not doing anything malicious. In case of any suspicious behaviors – look for the closest CO and guide him. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/3bf611841a937720e63f22a94d96585d5fc578b0.jpg[/img]
[h1]Checking the applications[/h1]
 
Prisoners have a right to ask for a release due to special occasions like a funeral. Sometimes they want to file a complaint or a request.
And some of them are filing for a pardon. So you have to dig through that paper, check all the signatures, stamps, and content of these documents before you Approve or Deny someone's application. 

Double-check – cause mistakes in this field have consequences.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ecfaae96ea45e338e32e7519476c3c67dda23030.jpg[/img]
[h1] Execution[/h1]
 
Among all your Prisoners, there will be ones who committed the most brutal crimes. The only journey that waits for them is the one to the Death Cell. And your job is to escort them… and manage the whole process. While the entire experience is rather grim, there're rules and you need to ensure that everything is in check.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9ce0e63ff392aba27cf572b27fedda1eb6156be4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Releasing the Prisoners[/h1]
 
Before you release a Prisoner, you need to follow the utmost detail of the procedure. Check if all documents are correct, search him. If everything is ok – you're good to give him back his belongings and release him to the rest of the society.

notes.title: Inside Gameplay: Prison Guard Daily Routines PART 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0138274a3aa2ce2db0b97075bfc78ca5286045cc.jpg[/img]

I bet you're curious about all the things you'll be able to do in the full version of Prison Simulator. So without further ado - let's dive into all the Routines you need to perform as a Prison Guard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e00de33e0bbb1f7c9c4b6fd6537ee8cdf6c8f10e.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Cell Shakedown[/b][/h1]

You don't want any contraband and illegal stuff to go unnoticed under your command, do you? So check out every inch of the cells. 
Trust me - inmates are desperate. They will hide stuff even in the shitter. 
Once you find some hidden stashes, it's up to you to decide what are you gonna do with your findings. 

Are you gonna do the right thing and confiscate the stashed stuff? Or maybe you'll leave it where it was? Or take it for yourself? 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/948233e4d46c316bc35ffecf4987feb8eec15c81.jpg[/img]
[h1]Prisoners' Reception[/h1]

You're the "Welcome Committee " for the new Prisoners. Your job as a Prison Guard is to make sure that you're taking in the right guy. That means - fingerprints and documentation checks. (You don't want to bring in the wrong guy, do you?) 
Check the personal items that the new guy wants to bring in (you won't believe what people can smuggle in a shampoo bottle). 
Give away the pack of basic supplies and wish "good luck" to this poor sod. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/44bef1ce7316aa98e0b1eb715c4599f53be4618a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Prison Yard[/h1]

Even these poor Jail bastards need to take a breath of fresh air. But don't forget that they're still a bunch of degenerates who need constant supervision. So have an eye on everyone. Stop the fights! Punish the vandals! 
Hell - you can even order them to get back in the cells if they don't know how to behave. You're calling the shots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b23e29b4a6bd85c964a1bad4a10c2d985b82b5bf.jpg[/img]
[h1]Cafeteria [/h1]
 
You need to make sure that no one will start a riot over the spoon of a mush. So maintain peace and order at any cost. No fights, shouting in the mess hall. So if any of that happens, you need to be swift on your feet and act quickly. 
If it seems that they won't obey, you're allowed to use force. Or try to solve the problem verbally. It's up to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/61b09759763821f596fbe11680939ad40f5a31fc.jpg[/img]
[h1]Attendance Check[/h1]

The best way to check is if you don't have any fugitives here. First, arm yourself with your trusty clicker. Then, open every cell in the block and start the counting. Of course, some of your Prisoners won't cooperate. That's where you need to use your "persuasion" techniques. You can either yell at someone, make him step out of his cell, or just count him either way. Your choice.

But remember - you need to have them in check. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d90536199fdc607be6104cfea644e2f378ca8253.jpg[/img]
[h1]Shower[/h1]

I'm waiting for all the jokes in the comments ;) 
But srsly - hygiene is essential. Every person who has been in the men's locker room knows that. Here is no different. There are too many inmates and too few showers. So your job is to assign prisoners to empty cabins. Check out the washed-out and still make sure that they are on their best behavior. Is someone taking too much time, and that makes everyone waiting and getting angry? You know what to do - act as a Prison Guard would. 

This is the first part of the quick look at the Routines available in the full version of Prison Simulator.

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Dealing with prisoners? Not in my prison.
notes.content:
[b]hello Officers,[/b]

We don't have good news today. Our senior CO caught several other guards trading with inmates. 

One of them got so deep into the business that he just said goodbye to his job! If you enjoy your job, don't go that way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9ee79319ec6856b3db6eead838242f2f470fa39e.png[/img]

The warden issues a mass dismissal letter several times a year for dealing, stealing, and other misconduct by our COs. He tries to cover it up so we don't lose our ranking position.

Imagine what would happen if the government found out about these misdeeds!
It would be the end of our warden. Therefore, what happens in this prison stays in this prison. It's hard, but it has to be that way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/63e6f9dd80e6cbd22d14b050b07ffdf186869d8e.png[/img]

So! If you have any idea to do business with an inmate, keep in mind that your colleagues are watching you. One will simply give you a warning and the other will contribute to the end of your career. 

Simple? Simple. 

---

[b]If you want to play our Prison Simulator: Prologue, don't forget to add our game to your wishlist to get the notification just after the release.[/b]

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Bad prisoners... really bad prisoner!
notes.content:
Hello Officers,

Our prisoner is relaxing instead of working.  It looks like the CO is already very upset. Generally, according to prison rules, it should not happen that way for a guard to not control his emotions, but we are only human and sometimes these situations happen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7ac6f376c25e9bd599b52c78b1137ecee33b4a07.png[/img]

It is important that you do not go too far. We always start by trying to have a conversation. Let our inmate know that his behavior is unacceptable. If that doesn't help, we have a choice of different ways to force our inmate to return to work.

One of them is the baton. Two solid hits across his back and he should return to work begging for peace on his own. However, if our delinquent is stubborn, sometimes you just have to remind him who irules this prison.

In addition to the baton, we also have pepper spray, although we use it more to pacify aggressive prisoners, and a taser, which should also not be used as a means of first response. 

You must keep your eyes open during the workshop routine. Sometimes inmates will stand at their workstation and pretend to work, but when you get closer you will find out that it's just a pretense, and our inmate is obviously slacking off. 

Also be vigilant during the search. You never know where prisoners will decide to hide a hammer or a file. We don't mean to imply anything - sometimes you just might be surprised.

All tools should be returned to the storage room immediately after the search is complete. Occasionally, someone may try to bribe you to keep these stolen screws or other items in their equipment.
Of course you are not supposed to agree to this, but if you do, remember that the consequences can be unforgivable!

Once one of the guards allowed an inmate to take a file. We patched up the hole in the fence for 3 days. Well! Remember to keep an eye on these degenerates.

End of roll call,, go back to your work.

Thank you so much for reading our update. If you want to try Prison Simulator: Prologue, you can add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431610/Prison_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Catching fire and bug fixes.
notes.content:
[b]Hello Officers,[/b]

Looks like us inmates have found a new way to have fun. Richard caught one of them setting fire to prison property. We're sure it's all to burn us with this building. Be careful out there. This is a warning to remember. Fire is no fun! Fire is to be avoided. 

I am decreeing new rules for our prison! No matches or lighters of any kind, including smokers.

Objection? No problem! If you get burned, you'll stop complaining.

Your best warden.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/fce3f70d155f63c0dc74d49efa2d4fe924e1d0db.png[/img]

[b]Our team has been working on the bugs reported by our testers and the Discord server community, and so we've prepared a short list with the most important information for you:[/b]

- We fixed the lighting. 
- Added a notification that a player cannot use an item for a specific reason
- Fixed an issue that was causing prisoners' mouths to stick together.
- Improved the way guards find their way around, so they no longer walk into furniture and other items

And more!


We would like to tell you, that we are so proud of you -  our community. Everyday you help us to improve our game. Thank you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431610/Prison_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Once upon a morgue...
notes.content:
[b]Hello, officers,[/b]

How's your week going? Are the inmates causing any problems? We hope our training in pacifying these bastards has helped you a lot.

Unfortunately, we have some bad news. We recently had a strange case of six deaths in one week. The guards in Block C are complaining that they can't do anything with it, and the morgue staff are already refusing to take any more dead bodies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4f9f051bde41172789b3a63f707e3749f277a50d.png[/img]

If you would be so kind as to help them out a little? We don't want our prison to make the headlines as a place to dispose of the margins of society.

If any of you haven't been to the morgue yet, unfortunately you'll have to wait a bit longer. Access is granted to guards of the full version. 


[b]Bug fixes[/b]

We recently received a report of an elastic man walking around our prison - well, not everyone should go out in the sun. We dealt with the problem and no one scares anyone anymore.

The toothpaste has lost its magical properties and its model no longer goes through the parcels. 

Our warden was listening to the radio so loudly that it could be heard across the hall. Fortunately, a gentle reminder worked and now you can enjoy the peace and quiet. 

And perhaps most importantly, occasionally an inmate would disappear during the evening attendance check, but fortunately our new security measures have had the desired effect and everything is now ok.

That's everything for today. We hope the end of this week will be pleasant and easy for you.

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Kitchen, plates and other knives
notes.content:
[b]Hello Officers,[/b]

Did you know that the weekend starts today? Or, do you know what that means? It means that our inmates will spend it exactly the same way they always do. Well, life in prison is not the most pleasant.

So let's take a look at our convicts and see what they are doing today. 

Well, it looks like it's just before lunchtime today. Prisoners often work in the kitchen, helping to prepare meals - of course, we do everything we can to choose the best-behaved candidates for this challenging job.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f3d4d4e43b53c93bb40fc3cad8411d1837cc6847.jpg[/img]

Sometimes, unfortunately, it happens that the meal will cause severe indigestion and then you have to go to the kitchen and ask around a bit. You may find that someone has taken part in it. 

[b]Some side quests may be related to this place. It's worth doing thorough research. [/b]

Kitchen will be available in full version of Prison Simulator.


[i]*Screenshots don't have to present the real look of our game. They were taken in-engine.[/i]

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Guards' room? Yes, please!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Officers,[/b]

It's been a long time since we've seen you here. Time for a little announcement!

While you've been away, our decorators have been hard at work refreshing one of the most important rooms for you - the guard room. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/70438daa3b64d9fcefe32ccc0123bf9a50770589.jpg[/img]

You'll never have to eat last Friday's sandwiches again! Reheat sausages in the kettle! Spend millions on a physiotherapist to get rid of the side effects of sitting on a dreadful, uncomfortable couch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/f608d504d9ba105c46489987040c77b79b4a9c15.jpg[/img]

From now on, brand new equipment is at your disposal! Of course, it's better not to touch it, it will last longer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/70438daa3b64d9fcefe32ccc0123bf9a50770589.jpg[/img]

[b]But to the point![/b]

Your favorite activities like playing darts are still here! The wicked guard is still willing to teach you a few tricks! Only the decor is beautiful and fresh. Oh yeah, can you smell that fresh air?

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Sometimes our inmates like to stink.
notes.content:
[b]Hello Officers,[/b]

Do you think it is the end of your shift? Because what? Friday? Well.. yes, it is the end of the shift for today. This is the best time to relax, and stop thinking about prisoners.

But actually we have something to tell you before you go home.

There are some routines, that are not available in the Prison Simulator: Prologue. One of those routines is Shower time!

[b]Sometimes our inmates like to stink.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f5a2f2c5f3c1e555556b1b7fe76774767d7aaef2.png[/img]

Well. Not everyone likes to shower. Anyway, your job is to send as many prisoners to the showers as you can. Keep in mind, however, that these inmates may have a lack of patience, and that may result in fights and unnecessary arguments.

Give them towels and wait. Then take dirty towels from them and repeat. Be aware of fights and try to keep calm. You can do it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/3ea406f0a7ad0f67e0c79c115f0de5cead0d7bfa.png[/img]

*This update contains screenshots that were taken in engine and do not represent the current look of the game.

[h3]Have a nice weekend Guys![/h3]

By the way... May the soap be with you!

notes.title: Prison Simulator - Prison cells, equipment, upgrades and searching
notes.content:
[b]Hello Officers,[/b]

As you may know, our inmates very often complain about the lack of proper equipment in the prison cells. Sometimes, unfortunately, we have the impression that the men have mistaken the prison for a hotel in the Maldives, but this topic is not very comfortable.

Unfortunately, inmate satisfaction has a huge impact on our facility's overall ranking. So we cannot allow them to live (as prisoners should) in humble, grey, dirty cells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/66b18cc25a7edf357bb16813f858a29c4ef73f3f.jpg[/img]

In the computer you will find access to an online store that offers all kinds of equipment for our cells. You can find everything you need there, from beds and bedding to lockers and chairs. If we can afford it, you can even buy those bastards gold bars. Just to keep the prison running.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/db7a4111a7c5503c687bdf7401aeb4fbfd079103.jpg[/img]

[b]Another thing, probably one of the most important.[/b]

The more furniture they have in their cells, the more places we have to search. I promise you right now, even a chair will be covered with contraband as much as possible! The cabinets above the sink are a cluster of illegal items. Be careful. New objects mean new challenges. Of course, don't forget that the delinquent himself may also have something in his pants. Who knows what other ideas they will come up with and where they will decide to hide their possessions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2f2d38e7188935043d1cf115b70e387c2953a18a.jpg[/img]

Well! End of roll call.
Just remember, I'm keeping an eye on you.

[i]*The screenshots are not real part of the gameplay[/i]

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Block B and the routines
notes.content:
[b]Hey Officers,[/b]

Today we're going to take a quick look at Block B. This is where our polite (or not) convicts spend most of their time. Here they have the best basic equipment in the world like a toilet, sink and bed. I remember when in the 70's the warden ordered to put gold bars in the cells, to replace the toilets and they even had chairs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/03bfd462d8b713694395d7ccffbd0c129165e0ee.jpg[/img]

Those were weird days, but later they sold everything because money started to run out!

There's a lot of work here, too. Every morning you have to come in here and get those naughty people out of their cells. There is no sleeping until noon. In the evening the situation suddenly changes and our morning sleepers do not even think about returning to their cells. What a surprise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38933921/dd51bbe615c09dd7233f479e3af70dcae4063d6a.jpg[/img]

Then there were two options left: either you talk or you pull out a baton.
Unfortunately, there is no other option, no one will ask them to kindly return to their bunks.

During your leisure time, we sometimes visit this place too. Sometimes the inmates would like to tell us the story of their lives, and these boring stories are good for your boredom.

If you're a good guy and have contacts, you can also trade, but as far as I know, that's what the man in the guards' room teaches. He's the boss in that area. 

There are also requests for cigarettes or other sweets, well it's up to you what you do with it, but I always have a chocolate bar with me. In case of rebellion I am not afraid for my ass.

Sometimes they will ask you if you can pass something to someone, or if you can turn a blind eye to those beautiful razor blades, hammers and other illegal items in their packages, or if you can give someone a gentle beating - although gentle is not always the case.

People think officer work is such a boring, tedious job.
Actually, you have a lot of opportunities, but if you want, sitting on the bench is really cool too.

[b]That's probably all we wanted to tell you today. The prologue is getting closer, and in the meantime, feel free to add our game to your wishlist to get notified when it's ready![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431610/Prison_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Prologue - Achievements Reveal
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Guards,[/h2]

You've been working very diligently these past few months, the inmates even tolerate you, but...

Can you handle the latest challenge that Prison Simulator: Prologue will throw at you? Can you get them all?

[h3]All right, enough with the serious motivational speech, time for Friday's news![/h3]

In [b]Prison Simulator: Prologue[/b] you will be able to see some of the achievements that you are familiar with from the demo version. The decision to include them in the next part was based on the complexity of the gameplay in the prologue itself.

Which of the achievements will return, you will see for yourselves, in the meantime we will present to you the achievements that you don't know yet.

[b]1.Not on my watch![/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0bfb0f866522fcb09417e97be94d92b85119b76e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/105062088b9aa9b87d511d1752998f69dee444c4.png[/img][/url]

This achievement is one of the easiest and hardest at the same time. To get it, all you have to do (or as much as) is master rebellion. Simple right? Not one daredevil has tried to do it, but not one has fallen in the fight against the convicts.

[b]2 - Diplomat[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/630d49025071e628b1597ad68e0eda9f90bd1c44.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e4872f0b03184e27b0bc03005dec1d3f2f77ecee.png[/img][/url]

What's there to say. We solve problems with talk, not fists. So much for that. And if you don't like talking, there are only fists left, but this achievement won't be for you.

[b]3 No guns allowed[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ffd06485fff10fc1aee826e493ff75e5bd4d283f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e4b5ee4845e4a9679f2c51f4f6dfb052ee08e403.png[/img][/url]

This achievement is reserved for true professionals. The prison is on fire, the convicts are vandalizing everything they can, the guards are running scared... and in the middle of it all - YOU. The hero of the prison, the guard of all guards, who deals with such problems without reaching for a gun. Is it a dream or a reality?

[b]4. The story begins[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0633869e0fdad85d0c19a82a4d628ed96f72ad1b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2abcf9b934d522711c19e7a81752a41692411bb3.png[/img][/url]

This achievement is for persistent players who complete Prison Simulator: Prologue. And that's it. 

[b]5. Finders keepers[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/98bffe0bda00735b9de118096c051c36eab242ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2a1e45cd8bd89ff06bc00b095ea9d9a0f68adbee.png[/img][/url]

Fortunately, our prison facility... Oops, it's not that easy!

[b]6. Student[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a32d85b1c94754b044caaed2f2adaaf89362a2ec.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8f3a48ef6c8dc95dcdc5a8d94c0f86dc7d468524.png[/img][/url]

Remember those days when you went to school? Or do you still go to school? This achievement will make you feel like you're in a real... we're kidding.

Purchase the first skill to unlock this achievement. This skill will REALLY come in handy for you.

[b]7. Rambo[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4ff6b37e44b515dc966f89242472f739569f7e05.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/75c3cc390a98acf24e676149bbe863074c2ce7bf.png[/img][/url]

I don't think we need to explain...


[b]That's all we wanted to show you today. 
Let us know in the comments which achievement you like best![/b]

And if you've earned all of the achievements while playing the demo, join our Discord server where we look forward to seeing your screenshots!

[url=https://discord.gg/m3gTQxE][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b3f6f33f04fc3e96c985cbc03392b5f70fec42d9.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b3f6f33f04fc3e96c985cbc03392b5f70fec42d9.gif[/img][/url][/url]

Cheers!

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Prologue - Environment update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards,
[/h1]
[h2]It is Monday again and we know that many of you are out of energy, but we have good news for you![/h2]

[h3]First dialogue with Richard tells us that we came back to work just after a huge Riot. As you could see on one of our trailers, this is not a playground. Prisoners are furious, aggressive and they don't want to stop destroying everything.[/h3]
[h3]

To make this as much realistic as we could, we decided to change the main scene a little. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0b673c13bfa9d97ad337259ee7dbf78d20f9cdd7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/dd128171d50b6f5ca40e712bd1baa105522f055c.png[/img]

[h3]The corridors don't look so pretty anymore. Prisoners have knocked over benches, scattered documents, and even covered the entrances to some rooms with rubble.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ce66c55461acbae518c57a623669170326f545ab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2976cbe2374c74c63b0ab7ef0863f3ab7df1978a.png[/img]

[h3]Several fires have broken out throughout the prison, which must be extinguished immediately. Rooms like the workshop and the canteen were completely occupied by the rioters.[/h3]

notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards,[/h1]

[h2]During the last few weeks, we focused on Prison Simulator: Prologue. We have to fix all of the bugs, check every routine, and make sure that our prologue is ready for release.[/h2]

[h3]First of all, we decided to change the perk panel. It looked very similar to the previous one, and we didn't want to keep it anymore.[/h3]

Evening count
Canteen
Workshop
Yard
Monitoring
Parcel searching

Documents
Cells shakedown
Free time (with mini-games)

notes.title: Weapon Cleaning, Lock picking, and monitoring routine
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Players,[/h1]

[h2]It is Monday again![/h2][h3] (It is our favourite welcome text lately)[/h3]

[h3]We saw that some of you were a bit bored during the free time in Prison Simulator. For many months we’ve been developing new mini games and events you will have a chance to see soon. It is very important for us to listen to your requests and suggestions. This time it looked very similar. [/h3]

[h2]Weapon cleaning station:[/h2]

[h3]As you may know there are many weapons in our game. (More about weapons and their mechanics you will be able to see by playing our Prison Simulator: Prologue which will be available soon on Steam, for free.)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/da050f776c301432635d0325090f74d06c00359f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/86a7ba18ef5d9fcaa1995bd6d99e297b08983065.jpg[/img]

[h3]When you use your weapon it gets dirty and finally you have to clean it. We have prepared a special table in the shooting range. You just have to go there and choose the weapon you want to clean. Simple, isn’t it? [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/40922c7ea33e1d3c9bbaaa95cd58dc83e6af3775.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7130f0cc23e240e151e861f4b9a88301d64663cd.jpg[/img]

[h3]You have many tools available like compressed air, cloth and a ramrod. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b00ec27ae57129821a803cdb0d87bb21f78f8a71.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f95b6d6ff462597361ed69b3e3ae7b4886db4ca4.jpg[/img]

[h2]There are also lock picking and camera fixing mini games.[/h2]

[h3]We’ve been working on the monitoring routine recently. You have to go to the monitoring room, and use the computer. It will show you a few cameras around the whole prison. You can change the view, move the cameras and zoom in and out. If you see something suspicious you can report a prisoner to the nearest guard. There are many options for what you can do with a naughty convict. 
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f696f73cebdd12e356ccef6924f19eb380c397af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6dd56dceafe8b0dd59d607812e9ad6c4bee3d833.png[/img]

[h3]Before releasing Prison Simulator: Prologue we have to be sure that we will show you much more than in the demo. You will see new routines, events, quests etc. 
More information soon![/h3]

[h2]Cheers :)[/h2]

notes.title: Prison Simulator Update: vending machine, shop and items
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards,[/h1]

[h2]This update is slightly different from the ones you have seen so far. We will not focus on new mechanics or improved routines. Today we will show you the items you will be able to find in the vending machine or in the store. We will show you their statistics and the overall impact on the gameplay.[/h2]

[h2]First meeting: Vending machine[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/385ab2c309b2c4ddaee4c3af6adce593e426199f.png[/img]

[h3]You will find Vending machines in several places. The first one is a corridor near the passage to block B. The second one is in the social room and the third one in the infirmary.[/h3]

[h3]Interact with one of them using the key (default: E) and see what you can buy.
On the left side you will see your inventory divided into two tabs: legal and illegal. On the right side you will see all items currently available for purchase.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/93a58109d09c86afa1358833b88da0bef0af799f.png[/img]

[h3]When you click on an object, you will see its description.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6850deb9dbb48d7bf3c09a471e1fc2afe5d1ee42.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ec5bca2641c3ea6e077339c5897ddac049e9c98c.png[/img]

[h2]Second meeting: store[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/dbc5d5a15394689e0e4019a84e82ac2bd6286709.png[/img]

[h3]The store is available in the warden's computer. It will be unlocked during one of the story days.
In the store you can buy many interesting improvements like cameras, showers, gym equipment or radio.
Many of your purchases affect the prisoners' respect. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a100b092803b73c1787e9267700525b0652050c0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c2c6cf1b150fc0a8fbf595d0cbe4363eb0ba6fa2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6d1b01a12f8c60ed76c93eff52549d502408179a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/26c053302dab7793e4d215a5aa8f25bbd5068c5f.png[/img]

[h3]You also have access to many colorful and unique skins. They also raise the level of your relationship with prisoners. After all, they can do much for you if you give them a comfortable bed. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/5413c6eb309f6a52684fdfa5344e315e16c68bc9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6b631a20083214907d53cd7c1068133e99ae054e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a3a1ef13de64c64c31a31f9376919180dca1ad1c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/218cbc459a1027bb91cb4ddf2cecf8a738ad95d9.png[/img]

[h2]Items in the vending machine:[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0cc4c3fddbc60308d93d55435a4afbc13638c017.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/3f9724ca595171b9586a9ee0eff17587247c6cf4.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Contains natural orange juice. Heals 300 HP[/h3]

notes.title: UPDATE - Free time changes, new mini games, better collectibles and more...
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards,[/h1]

[h3]We are glad you played our Halloween demo update. Many of you unlocked special achievement! To get it you had to collect all candies hidden in the prison. Wow! You are awesome.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/06b4eb735d14cc5978244a1259773c104a5dfa58.png[/img]

[h3]But Halloween time is ending. It won't be available soon. 
Don't worry! We are working on another way how you can get this time-limited achievement if you are an achiev-hunter. More info will be published soon.[/h3]

[h2]It is the time to take a look at Free Time.[/h2]

[h3]A few days ago we asked you what do you think about our demo. 
Your feedback is the most important for us, because without it we don't know what exactly we should improve. [/h3]

[h3]Today, we want to focus on Free Time. Some of you said there are not many mini games, you have to do always the same and the longer you play the more boring it is. [/h3]

[h3]In our demo you don't have access to all features. 
You could visit shooting range, play darts and lift weights.[/h3]

[h3]We want to tell you a bit more about activities, that will be available in full version.[/h3]


[h2]1, Weapons cleaning[/h2]

[h3]This mini game will be available in the shooting range. when the gun gets dirty, it may not work properly. On the shooting range you will find a special stand that will make the cleaning process easier. You will find there cloths, ramrod and all necessary tools. We are also working on different weapons to make this mini game interesting and various.[/h3]

[h2]2. Lock picking[/h2]

[h3]Sometimes prisoners like to destroy something. One of their favorite activities is clogging locks. Your task is to get rid of the problem. Can you do it? You need to get inside the lock to be able to fix it.[/h3]

[h2]3. Clogged showers[/h2]

[h3]During the shower routine one of the prisoners decided to push something into the shower headset. Great idea, You have to take care of it now. Remember to look well. Sometimes it is just sabotage and sometimes it is a great opportunity to hide something illegal.
[/h3]
[h2]4. Fix a broken camera[/h2]

[h3]As a guard you want to know everything and see everyone. With the help of cameras it is even easy. But sometimes the cameras get damaged, hang up or just refuse to cooperate. Find a broken camera and look inside to fix it.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2a7d57e4225c9f099f5f3a89d8ee80818157aed3.png[/img]


[h3]We think that those mini games will be fresh, interesting and you will have fun! [/h3]

[h3]During the free time you will have vaious side quests to complete. You can get them from both quards and prisoners. They are connected to smuggling, finding lost items etc. Shhh! We don't spoil.[/h3]


[h2]The last thing for today is that we completely changed the Collectibles system.[/h2] 

[h3]They have gained a new user interface, 3D preview and a panel in the journal, which allows you to check the progress and discover tips which will help you with the next items. The reward system has also been improved. For finding all 10 collectibles the player receives:
[/h3]
[h3]- $500 for the player (in-game currency)
- $500 for prison (in-game currency)
- a special skin for one of the items
- Steam's achievement.
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/27d53a11ea6f62f4318cfdebbe9f91a225a700cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e2adfac9363a8052299715774393487045b38b50.png[/img]
[h2]That's all for today. 
Have a nice Monday![/h2]

[h3]Cheers :)
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/cf76ba86b0770ef97e13910594c0a358d10c5213.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/db5892e08b0bb4af133a1b16bd3d96795b90852d.png[/img]

notes.title: Prison Simulator Prologue - official announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards,[/h1]

[h3]You are great officers. Your service brings glory to our prison. Your games are extremely important to us. Even before the official release of the full version of the game, we are able to work with you, get feedback, and correct any mistakes. We make sure that even free samples of our game provide you the entertainment you want.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8e53489db45f3afe3f31642c69573e49aa0d3f10.png[/img]

[h3]We would like to officially announce that at the end of this year there will be a Prison Simulator Prologue - a free prologue of our game that will take you back to the past. You will have a chance to look at the rebellion that Richard and the warden mentioned. It is a very important part of the story, that's why we decided to show you that and let you feel it.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/109ac9774a75800c84e399219b6bd2b5385e093c.png[/img]

[h3]The prologue includes the rebellion and a fragment of the game after these events. You will have many quests to complete. Prisoners will become your greatest nightmare. It is up to you how you deal with it.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/158c7ddd0294a0beb154604893de11365fcf71db.png[/img]

[h2]Prison Simulator prologue will be available for free on the Steam platform. [/h2]

[h3]Unfortunately, the release of the full version of the game is delayed due to the many larger launches at the end of this year and the work on the prologue. We are expecting to release the game in 1st Q 2021.
Thank you so much for your support. We do our best to make our game ready to release. Additional time will help us to improve very important mechanics like riot, execution, random events, side quests, etc.
More information will be given soon. [/h3]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431610/Prison_Simulator_Prologue/]Prison Simulator: Prologue - Steam Page[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Prison Simulator - the story has begun
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards,[/h1]

[h2]We came here today to tell you the story, to show you our changes, fixes, everything that was an inherent part of the development. Let the journey begin![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/95a070e143fabfca03eb829d793083a8fd7f371f.png[/img]

[h3]One day we decided to sit together and think about something cool, something that will make players satisfied. Seems great? We were a small team. We didn't know much about making games! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b0084e47ae89eb2230d612ba585add0bdc6129d5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Well, we took a piece of paper and wrote down everything that we wanted to put into our game. We had only one question: how to put this into the computer? [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c491e18cb788cb6ea262eb67443bacb0973a8f0c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9e44a8de8e0a11cd18a0bab4e8e053a9ebda2743.png[/img]

[h3]Unity was our obvious choice because our programmer was good at C#. We spent many hours planning, creating, and coding. Well, we think it didn't look that bad. The prototype was ready. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/dded7e026a4884a51bf206f698f40296136b5532.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/326989299f44a227c158c24e35cdebad932187af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e3484cc80495c441491f2ed02d5ffaa5ad69dbc8.png[/img]
[h3]
By the time we hired more awesome people who do amazing animations, 3D models, and music! Our project was growing up. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6cac472f700979901291b5c921a7483dc5269b89.jpg[/img]
[h3]
During the development process, we had to fight with many bugs, glitches, and freezes. Everything was like a child who doesn't like vegetables. Sometimes we were so tired, but we told ourselves: we can do it![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4c5fe93a86f569be2b31f82063d9ed6a000bb257.png[/img]

[h3]Prison Simulator was an enormous project. It had to contain artificial intelligence, a large prison facility, many routines, items, quests, and even influential dialogues! Our designer wrote a Game Design Document, but nobody was able to read it because it has hundreds of pages. The description and total content were extremely wide.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/53fdbec0d5c391e73a03a9c7aa093a6f09c67099.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/40a407032f5d4424c08054680d7213a944339f4c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/409c87cd413cb6f71c8814130a2620dcaafb0da5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2b9e5ba8fca1de69d6a851f5036f218988a3b110.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/03becce501abdc1dac4040f18e29686d00b6e3a1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Making games is quite difficult. We were still a small company, and we had no experience at all! By the time we have grown and we decided to change some features, design, and graphics. You can see how many things look completely different than at the beginning of our journey.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f3089b8e8f89a40e33807fee64d08026f36678ee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/db4edb5f1ea2120ed6edd8163a80ac66170ea262.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/bc60070a8a2ed77c7c895d685eb4a7c2cc74d868.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/53e71266a1bedd51dd96dba466b7fd2da8736eea.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/33b4511194a77685eadf5aff739b9210f0027743.png[/img]

[h3]Finally, prisoners got their conversations, quests, and the possibility to trade with the player. They act like normal people. They are original![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/816b15544458b7fcc23da739003ed9197d0dd191.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/fe1e972636793f9fd03a568b6f95a8dabbf4ee47.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/921d4bfbafbf2752c890291e6db61efdfff17c01.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0add01f15eeb668060c03d141060ffc3799d0fc5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/5bf4f5a490b87c5bce884b4eb6891a65a1ce28d6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c265c3ce58c66853c1d641cd420317b8e4ed4073.png[/img]

[h3]Okay, maybe one day they lost their minds, but now everything runs perfectly.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f6f415b41122d5edaeffb1c8b006f9288f0c8261.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/61ab4b7aa0d3fb886de11eb8e613b14a4070d1aa.png[/img]

[h3]Prison Simulator includes its own story, random events, and side quests. You can either enjoy your free time by playing minigames or fix broken things - cameras, showers, or even weapons![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/cf76ba86b0770ef97e13910594c0a358d10c5213.png[/img]

[h3]We hope you appreciate our screenshots and contrast what we've done. [/h3]

[h2]Thank you for reading our short story. 
Baked Games[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/db5892e08b0bb4af133a1b16bd3d96795b90852d.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE - This is the end of the prisoner's journey...
notes.content:
[h1]Good Afternoon Guards,[/h1]

[h3]Today we want to announce something... hard for us. One of our prisoners will be lost this evening.
It is the time to take him to death rows. Well... maybe he was a good guy, maybe he commited a terrible crime, maybe... You don't know it, we don't know it. Only he knows what he did during his life.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/88083cb4330371fe69cbb3a5cd6755c9c1278ac6.png[/img]

[h3]He is not ready for that. You can't be ready for your death, he will sit on the chair, and wait for you.
You must fasten the belts, pick up the sponge and place it on his head.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/961dbece70e05207273188d54395fa793926f637.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ccbedba03afd370b6700ef30d9c69b8317a693c4.png[/img]

[h3]Don't forget to ask about the prisoner's last words. It is very, very important.

When everything is ready, go to the panel and use it to set the volts, ampers and turn on fuses.
It is the time to pull the lever. Close your eyes. It is not a nice view.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/916b8244c4b6ab8628a06e3f0d4bb9675bab07bf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a15faee0a9e4a42b6a2011f609fa7be9b2846c93.png[/img]
[h3]
You don't have to do anything else. Morgue stuff will take care of the body.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0be521eaf527d20b75539b2e92b2d755bb5372f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/159517623662bd83256b699ad1e3e90fa78265ff.png[/img]
[h3]
Remember, it is only a game. We don't support the death penalty. [/h3]

[h2]Cheers,[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/cf76ba86b0770ef97e13910594c0a358d10c5213.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/db5892e08b0bb4af133a1b16bd3d96795b90852d.png[/img]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards,[/h1]

[h2]We are glad you played our game. It is very important to know your opinion. You've written many reports and given us amazing feedback. It is awesome. [/h2]

[h2]We fixed some bugs and add general improvements.

Take a look:[/h2]
[h3]
GENERAL[/h3]

We fixed teleportation issue visible between the workshop and the solitary quest. Now prisoners go back to their cells without any special effects.

We've changed the key responsible for weapon selection wheel from "MMB" to "Q".

Dialogues with prisoners with high respect level are now shown as they should.

[h3]WORKSHOP[/h3]

Prisoner who started fire during the workshop routine is no more afraid of going back to his cell. Congratulation Prisoner. 

We have also fixed waypoints in the workshop so prisoners know where should they be. No more walking around the workshop.

[h3]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h3]

Achievement "The cause of fire was fire" is now easier to receive.

[h3]YARD[/h3]

Timer from lifting weights quest starts after the tutorial, not during reading popups as before.

[h3]SHOOTING RANGE[/h3]

Accuracy is now counted properly.

Your game no more ends before finish conditions.

Your records looks much better than before.

[h3]TRANSLATIONS[/h3]

We changed translations and fixed spelling issues in both Polish and English version.

[h3]DIALOGUES[/h3]

We've added three new dialogues between you and the prisoners.
Two when you talk to easy prisoner, and one when you talk to neutral prisoner.

Pro tip: Milk bars are very, very needed!

[h3]PARCELS[/h3]

Items have fixed sizes and they look cool now. 

We fixed joints positions in a lower can. They don't go out of the item now.

Materials of cans are lighter so they match other items.


Hope you like our Demo! 

Best greetings from Baked Games Team :)))

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/db5892e08b0bb4af133a1b16bd3d96795b90852d.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #19 - Bug fixes, new features and shopping.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Dear Players,[/h1]

[h2]Today is Monday... oh. We say it very often. Doesn't matter. Today we come to you with another update based on last changes, bug fixes and new features! So don't waste time and let's get started![/h2]

[h3]1. Inventory is now divided into three tabs. [ legal, illegal and quests ]. When you have many items it is easier to find something just by clicking one of the tabs. Simple, nice and player-friendly.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6392126967b2ad9f79fd1d2b1a9caacac5909799.png[/img]

[h3]2. Below Tutorial Tab you will find new button [ Meaning of icons ]. We use a lot of icons in Prison Simulator so sometimes you can forget about one or two of them. This tab is a kind of personal assistant.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/53e4c8f717d9388d06cf29892e1986034fc5484f.png[/img]

[h3]3. Briefing has summary panel which contains the most important information from your whole day.[/h3]

[list]
[*] Experience - how much exp did you get during the day
[*] Your money - earned money from routines, deals and bets
[*] Cost of damage [ work in progress ] - cost of damage made by prisoners
[*] Deaths - how many prisoners died during your shift

[*] Salary - money you earned
[*] Bribe - amount of money from bribes
[*] Other income - income from deals, bets etc.

More about respect we will tell you in another update :)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0d1a36eaf5a78f3f99dc72322494a966190152c6.png[/img]

[h3]4. Upgrade your workshop - When you have access to warden's computer you can buy new things. For example new workstations. [/h3]

Just open desktop:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/016a87fc7d729867ea6fe8cbe8ebc94eb9e0cad2.png[/img]

Choose cool web:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/19895b8c3aec21019ef84d5d14d4ba6142e68889.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4f692c83c85e78dc1a3a0f2c36c496f69cd1f027.png[/img]
[h3]
You can also buy some gym items.[/h3]

[h1]BONUS:[/h1]

notes.content:

[h2]Locker Room[/h2]

First, and well-known place is locker room. You start your day right here. This is also Richard's the most favourite room. But sometimes he goes out. Sometimes.

[h2]

notes.title: Update #17 - This is my long life in the prison...
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Players![/h1]

[h2]It is Monday again... but! We hope that we can make you happy with our new update.[/h2]

[h3]Today we want to focus on prisoners because they are the most important part of prison system. 
We've shown you characters creator, choosing names, voices and bodies for your convicts. Now it is the time to show you their life and how does it look like in our facility. Take a look![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c173153ce4162a4bce17656c4cee42b18523e82c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ce89b04ac78f4ae93c57fae0d88e6b270dbc05a9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7726e83106b4256a15fff84be5d8b8a42a2f14f4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/917a2a2e8b425f93896ef574ef9273c3fa2768ff.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c4582d27cca90878aece0fe764041d1456332bdb.png[/img]

Prisoners spend most time in the cells block - Block B. Here they have beds, sinks, toilets and other furniture that you buy during the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f192c938edbce5dd72623616a029ef6393b977c9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6e711ef65ee8af1d92b8f76e5afd13124de9542f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0f34e18b567f1765d68c352b670ea8082e7d268f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e8e4c64d0cac60646bf93becc38c678ada8482fb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9af0e37ed32eabd0f4b14408b8d8d8acd9cbe5d1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/fe1e972636793f9fd03a568b6f95a8dabbf4ee47.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6a9a4c6b3a1676cd567c5cb82285d246d8906893.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/921d4bfbafbf2752c890291e6db61efdfff17c01.png[/img]

You interact with them during presence check routine, you take them to the canteen and keep order there, you also go to the workshop where they work. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f2b14b838e92bb15ed6942cf63399b2995f8ce87.png[/img]

Prisoners have three types of personality: they can be polite and nice, neutral, and rude or even aggressive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d888041efcd36fbdd799cbedcb3a91e29303b902.png[/img]
*We know that the shadow is bugged :C

They have also a repsect level which is very important when you want to talk to them or just deal with them. The higher level of respect they have, the better quests you get. They have to just trust you enough to ask you for a favour. 

You can search the prisoner whenever you want. You're the guard, you set the rules. 

Prisoners may start fire, try to damage walls or just fight with other guys. You never know what they are planning. Maybe one day they will begin the riot? You will see...

More about prisoners' behaviour we will tell you during the next livestream so don't forget to check updates to be up to date.

[h3]Enjoy![/h3]

notes.title: Update #16 - You're not alone...
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Players,[/h1]

[h2]We hope your weekend was great and to keep your mood awesome we come to you with another Prison Simulator's update. Today we will focus on Guards, because we think that there was no information about them before.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/56645e52a9993b51a03232373658c0cad2f6b182.png[/img]

You can meet several different guards on your way. They can walk around the corridors, talk to each other or just spend time in Social Room. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0b4fef079fa2e1ae73da68109ee098be8e5505cf.png[/img]

When you come closer, it is possible that they will tell you something. It may be just something like "have a nice day" but it is very polite. Don't you think?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/5b41941b4d9e71f9b4a2fda7f128f8d744e249b8.png[/img]

First guard you will meet is Richard. He will be your guide during the game. He will tell you what to do at the beginning and he will return a bit later when it will be needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a9733c171f443249d3c535a0217553b1d9162041.png[/img]

If you want, you can talk to a chosen guard. There is a chance that he will ask you about something. Some guards in our Social Room know something special about items hidden in the prison. If you will have enough respect level, they will be more talkative and maybe they'll tell you a secret. So if you have some free time, feel free to talk to your coworkers. They don't bite. Sometimes...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/359fc18311dbcc4ff31d9ac93c3faae438b3479f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9612916e7c264e83d4ca1c51a8750bdabfc923f5.png[/img]

Sometimes you can meet very rude quard. He can be mean, sarcastic and even aggressive. It is better to stay away from examples like that. But you can always use your nightstick... Anyway, we don't encourage you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9f7d4d233aaf8d58632f55b29717a76766c948e3.png[/img]

Guards can also be very vigilant. When you're trying to deal with prisoners or to deliver the package, one of the guards may have red icon above his head. It means that he is suspicious. If you don't have any problems just try to avoid his sight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c1778646af034cb8211e1e5c7cad31280f57d2e6.png[/img]

When he will see you, the icon will change to the question mark. It will become more and more red.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f68070c5680e41c2f591e54af6896dde4ad8cf12.png[/img]

When it will fill with the colour, the guard will come to you and start the conversation. Now you have to choose how you will finish this. You can try to bribe him or you can try to ask... Your respect level is also very important here, if you don't want to lose your money. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6daad1e47e32971b36e979cad15c7a1fd9454efe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4edff225fdba6938933534c5e90fdf1fad2fe2e6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/211bd2bbf224820eb983af0ad786bd119d259f95.png[/img]

In Social Room you can play Darts. One guard wants to bet with you so if you are confident enough you can go and try to win. Good luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/cfd034658f55c0ff073b55d64bd3f4182001fdf1.png[/img]

Okay, so this is it about our awesome screws. They are ready to help you during the fight, or fire and to talk to you when you feel a bit alone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c5c5f5f92d3903f7d307652f734a0de936f17828.png[/img]

[h3]Stay tuned for the next update!
Bye![/h3]
