notes.title: Update #14 - Shower time!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guys![/h1]
[h2]
We come to you with a brand new update about showers! We've decided to give you the opportunity to breathe in fairly fresh air and just bathe the prisoners. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?[/h2]

[i] This routine is still in development so the general look of showers and other props may change.[/i]

[h3]It doesn't look so colorful, though. Imagine that now ALL of the prisoners will want to take a shower. What a tragedy! The prison could only afford a few cabins. Little time, a lot of dirt. [/h3]

[b]But relax! We're not gonna leave you alone with this.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0fa51bd11281f1ac19d04de80f01a568afbb5621.png[/img]

First, the prisoners have a satisfaction rate. The longer they wait, the more upset they will be. When their bar is full, they just leave. Nothing terrible, but you'll have problem. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/232f7e5b3d375f650b88bc5301141774cba7353a.png[/img]

You have to let a certain number of prisoners take a shower during your routine. If you let go more you will get a bonus, but if you do not complete your task you will lose respect and the task will be missed. We think this is quite understandable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a8370c89e027f8005716d1a3db7ab964dec53344.png[/img]

So how do you encourage a prisoner to scrub his body? It is simple. Give him a clean towel and he will do what is needed. They are quite clever. Sometimes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/313034c4d7d5cb13b4295e38db19548ddc563ad2.png[/img]

It will take time so be careful because other prisoners may get angry by the time. You have to watch them. All the time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0b54aef7c1a54531ebfd6fa12aeef97c125a08c3.png[/img]

When prisoners end taking shower take dirty towels back and put them to the box. And repeat. Again and again.
[h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/5bf4f5a490b87c5bce884b4eb6891a65a1ce28d6.png[/img]


We hope you like our update! Let us know if the comments what is your favourite routine!
We are waiting![/h3]

[b]Best wishes![/b]

notes.title: Update #13 - You wanna visit your family?
notes.content:
[h1]Hello our dear players![/h1]

[h2]Nice to see you here! We are glad to have such a great community like you that's why we come to you with a brand new update. We don't want to make you bored. You need new fixes! new facts! new features! No problem. We will do our best :)[/h2]

notes.title: Journal - the most important panel in the game.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guys![/h1]

[h2]We are glad to come to you with a new update!
Last week was full of hard work and we had to deal with many issues. 
Now we want to show you new features and give you an answer about dealing with prisoners![/h2]


[h1]Player Journal[/h1]

In the journal there are six labels which contain the most important information about inventory, quests and stuff like that. 

The first label - equipment. Here you can see all of your items. You can also asign food to one of the pocekts slots to access them by pressing Z or X on your keyboard. Different types of food and drinks change your stamina or health level so it is important to buy it. In case of long distance running or just ordinary fighting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e1a27e2b97f2be55d6f6f3f00c54daf311b6a965.png[/img]

Second label - quests. This is your personal assistant. You can check what quests you have already done, and how many of them you still have to complete. Under the primary list you can see side quests. Whenever you accept a quest from prisoners it will be availiable right here. Completed quests have "success" description. So it is easy to see your progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7886b8100c52252dfd3093205550fefce56d3a6d.png[/img]

Third label - map. Here you can see all your facility. Prison is a large building so you will need some help at the beginning. On the right side you have a list with all the most important places in your prison. Monitoring room, Warden's office or shooting range... Everything in one place. You can also see some icons like gamepad or a triangle. Gamepads icons mean that there you can play some mini games like lifting weights or darts, triangle shows your position. It is quite simple!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c54f712d3f0402fd4eecead2c1c53c7dc8382bab.png[/img]

Collectibles. Hmmm. That's quite interesting. Some items are hidden in prison. And this is all what we can say. Good luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/994ff1b5f3fb0ccbc3a678705e53f35d13e1b2e4.png[/img]

Skills. This panel shows you your skill tree. Every time you do your job well you get skill points. You can use them to unlock new skills. One of the most interesting skills is "trust". You can trade with more inmates and it depends on how much respect is between you and them. Nothing hard. Skills can be upgraded but you have to reach required level to have a chance to buy them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/77c0ad944c58b9d6b13e17ef971799240e1279eb.png[/img]

The last thing in our journal is tutorial. If you forget anything about the game you can go there and just check it. You will see game tips here as well. It is something like: "Hey mom did you see my pants?" She always know where your things are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d8ffcf0c7e2dac166a235605f2e062e3ec098393.png[/img]

Bonus: Many of you asked us about dealing with prisoners so we recorded short movie to show you how it looks like. Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=qTnaJzTaxFk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update #12 - Yummy, yummy food...
notes.content:
[h1]The canteen is one of the most visited places in prison. Convicts have to eat something, so they are happy to go there even if the food quality is similar to toilet water. 
[/h1]

[h2]
Once you get to the canteen, the prisoners will line up in queue for trays. Everyone who gets their portions goes to take a seat.
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/015ce7c74ab8acc7bde62380a4aa2694d323f34f.png[/img]

You have to remember that this is the place where prisoners may want to fight with each other or even try to kill someone. 
Don't panic. Stay calm. You're the only one who can settle the conflict. Use your weapon if you have to. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4c0d500c421e47ffaf39b66a62c3829bf8350d64.png[/img]

Various quests are also connected to the canteen. For example, someone may try to bribe the cook to add a bit of this and that to a meal of one of the prisoners... but we won't tell you any more details. You will find out for yourself how creative inmates can be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/207373b9e04f53ed71b7e80358fce7eadddf8c5e.png[/img]

Thank you so much for support!
We are glad we have such a great community.

Stay tuned,
and see you next time!

notes.title: Update #11 - Custom beds, custom crates, custom... toilets?
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Players![/h1]

[h2]We are coming to you with a fresh update![/h2]

[h3]Previous week was quite exhausting. We've been working on new features, new dialogs and new addons. It is important for us to make our game completed. We want to take care about all details. We listen to our players and we decided to change the walls because old ones weren't matchy. It is fully understable. So here it is! 
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/1ce67cd77c42287805ec7ee720c9d709cbb61677.png[/img]

You have to rememeber that this is a screenshot from development build so it may change a bit before the official release. 
We decided to use concrete walls instead of bricks. The prison cells are more bright and they look bigger. It also resolved the problem with wall paitings. Now they look nice and fresh. We think, the new style is much better. What do you think about it? 

We also improved lights a bit and added some details and more props. Going back to the requests. We changed the bed textures in our infirmary because previous one was too dirty and there was blood on it. After deep reserch, finding photos and reading we created new texture with quite clean duvet. We thinik it is now how it should be but take a look and say what you think. Your feedback is very important for us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e850e653791b2e4a1e5c2938c31bf9fe964f9810.png[/img]

The next thing is customization panel. First you have to reach required level and complete needed quest. Then you can go to the warden's room and use his computer. It is easy. Just press E key while looking at the screen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c322b9356ea40f215d710753983ebedeff8f435e.png[/img]

You have few options here. At the moment he most important is an option to buy new skins for your objects like sinks, beds and even crates! We wanted to give you a chance to customize the prison and feel like it is yours. We prepared few different skins. From the ordinary, not so good-looking to lavish and luxury ones (for example - golden crates). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7f598e8ae6fd39a5306d93719c63ba3c0fcd3801.png[/img]

This is all what we wanted to show you after the whole week. We are so excited that we can provide you more screens, movies and even streams. We are creating an awesome community together. 

Cheers,
and see you next time!

notes.title: Update #10 - don't touch my... - shakedown routine
notes.content:
[h1]Shakedown routine[/h1]

[h2]Hello guys! Welcome to our next update. 10th. Nice number. Today we're going to tell you a little bit about searching the cells and looking for illegal items called contraband.[/h2]

When you go to the cell you have few places to check. Sink, toilet and a bed. Remember that one object can be checked in different ways. For example if you exmine a sink you have to search the tap and the part under the whole object. You don't know if someone didn't hide something there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4f9f39d27e96a5a20a59783e73bd8112d8e30e14.png[/img]


You can find two types of objects - [b]legal[/b] and [b]illegal[/b]. If prisoner is allowed to have some objects you can take it or leave it. Your choice but remember he can have it so you might lose your respect level between you and the convict when you will take his goods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a383cd10f91913d95ec5cb69be6badd71ba6194e.png[/img]


When you find illegal stuff you have three options to choose from. You can take it, leave it or secure it. The last one don't give you this item. It is confiscated in the name of prison. By doing it you can increase your respect level between you and the guards. Fair enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b0330ad7cfee7e2bd2b7dc274a57d00b0f6e794f.png[/img]


Remember that you can search for the contraband even if it is not during the shakedown routine. You can do it whenever you want but you have to know that prisoners may be angry and even attack you if you are too middlesome. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/70d3478dc5b75aeeb8b531854076610065e90537.png[/img]


In cells you can also find graffiti made by prisoners. Sometimes there are also posters and other goods. They change during the game so you may see new objects everyday. It is something like a little tittle-tattle. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/891b88d9ffc89161109f561dad23d08fc3bfd819.png[/img]


Thank you so much for reading this update. We are working so hard to end and release Prison Simulator this year. We want to satisfy you - our players and we want to give you our final product without bugs, problems and other uncomfortable situations. We're adding new things, new objects, additional mechanics and we are polishing our base version of the game to have time to implement other content (for example from requests). 

[h2][b]Best wishes from our team![/b][/h2]

notes.title: Update #9 - prisoners, fights and other miracles...
notes.content:
[h1]Hello dear Players![/h1]

We are glad you were with us during the last livestream. We hope you are satisfied and you like the general look of our game. It is very important for us to stay in touch with you, and to show you the game even if it is still in development. We are adding new content and improving existing one. The best idea is to provide you many hours of good gameplay. That's why we are working on many additional quests not only connected to the main story.

First of all we want to end demo version to let some of you play Prison Simulator. We need to add some details and make sure everything is ok. Your feedback is very important for us because we are able to change something or fix bugs which we didn't notice. 

As we wrote before we are adding more parcels with different items inside to make it various. They are randomly generated so it is essential to preserve diversity.

We are also improving prisoners' behaviour during the attendance check routine. When you go to the cells block you have to open the cells. During this time, the prisoners leave their cells, but some stay in them. So you have to go up to them and talk to them. They'll give you all sorts of reasons why they don't want to go to the assembly. Sometimes it can make you laugh. You decide if you be polite and patient or if you force them to go to the rally. Your choice. 

During that routine you can notice that some prisoners are fighting. You need to react quickly enough. Once you have controlled the situation, it is your job to report the behaviour by radio and give the right punishment for an aggressive convict. It can be for example:

[list]
[*] no phones
[*] solitary
[*] no pass
[*] no cell leaving
[/list]

and more...

[i] If you want to stay tuned don't forget to join our discord server:[/i]

notes.title: Update #8 - Naughty prisoners...
notes.content:
[h2]Naughty prisoner? A fight? Attack on a guard?[/h2]
[h3]That's why we added different types of weapons to our game.[/h3]

Taser is available in the weapon selection wheel (open by pressing the middle mouse button).
It paralyzes your opponent within a few seconds so that he is confused or even unconscious. 

You have to rememeber that your stun gun has a limited battery so don't waste the energy. 

You may be able to stop the riot or an aggressive prisoner...


There is a tutorial which will help you with weapons and the ways of using them. So don't worry you won't feel lost!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7e0be479674a8c406625dfdae13ac0e34975ae3f.png[/img]

You can paralyze the prisoners who break the rules. They may be so aggressive so don't let them attack you or another guard. You have the power...at least when the battery is charged. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7b3cacb85d2818a6722b1f6c5b345b2adcd5919f.jpg[/img]

Sometimes you can also attack your mates. Maybe he drunk your coffee? Or he was not so nice? Your choice. Good luck!

notes.title: Update #7 - Accepting new prisoners
notes.content:
[b]Hi Guys! Welcome to the second devlog on our discord![/b]

We are working on many advanced features and fixing bugs which are annoying.  We're also adding new content to make routines interesting and to make the whole game thrilling. There are some random events like fire or riot.
You can deal with prisoners, complete some tasks for them or just talk to them.  There are many options which allow you to customize your prison (skins and additional items). You can also buy new cells but about this features we will tell you a little bit later. 

I know that you don't like waiting that's why we do our best to release this game as fast as possible.
Few days ago I decided to record a short video about accepting new prisoners because many of you asked me about it recently. 


[b]Routine: Accepting new prisoners[/b]

Once you've created your prisoners you don't have to worry about it anymore. New prisoners are randomly generated. During this routine you must check ID, block number, fingerprints and other convict's documents. Then check if he hasn's got any non-allowed items like needles, drugs or syringes. You decide if you accept or deny a prisoner. Have fun :)

It means that you don't choose how the new prisoners look like. They have also randomized names and voices. This routine is also based on your level. The higher level you have the more useful skills you can unlock. It will help you to do it faster and better.
This routine is one of the beginning's one. I'm glad I can show you how it looks like right now. Of course because game is in development some stuff may change a little bit but this routine will be a part of our game for sure!

[i][b]Stay tuned![/b][/i]

notes.title: Update#5 Character creator (movie)
notes.content:
At the beginning you will be able to customize your prisoners using avalible face and body models. You will have an option to choose the type and the pitch of their voices. You will also decide how you want to call them.

[previewyoutube=eZwk5ZMg8OE;full]
[/previewyoutube]

If you don't want to waste your time, you don't have to set the appearance of all of the 16 guys. "Random" and "Random all" functions are the major time savers! The first feature will help you with a single character, and the second one - with all the unfinished inmates.
What about new prisoners? Don't worry. You don't have to create them. The game will do that for you. :)
Then the "gang creator" comes. You can assign your convicts to the specific gangs. Also, you will be able to choose the gangs' names and symbols which will represent them. Gangs will influence the course of the gameplay.

notes.title: Update#4 Summary of the day
notes.content:
When the day is coming to an end, you must go to the briefing room. There you will see a summary of most of your expenses and how your decisions have influenced the respect of both the convicts and your colleagues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7e40e833c876c2c054e3b83bcfd5a55f9f7edc86.jpg[/img]

First of all, the summary allows you to analyse which of your actions were considered to be commendable, or quite the opposite. This will help you in the future to keep an eye on your decisions when it comes to resolving a conflict or fulfilling someone else's request. Which side will benefit and which side will suffer? Is it better to keep up your spirit among your colleagues today, or can you afford to get closer with prisoners?

Nevertheless, the financial aspect is crucial, too. You get your daily wage every day. It's your private money that allows you to buy the necessary items for your everyday work... or to bribe someone. But, besides your private money, you also have the prison budget at your disposal. You can use those funds only to buy some things to improve the facility.

If you wonder why a rank-and-file warden has an access to the prison budget...you'll see about that in due time.

notes.title: Today is your monitoring duty.
notes.content:
You have to be vigilant and keep an eye on any suspicious situations, and support the other guards with your own vision. They may overlook a lot and it is your job to help them. Prisoners pat themselves on the shoulders and shake hands? It seems like an innocent gesture, but they just want you to think so. They're probably exchanging something. We need to call a guard to check their pockets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e63a077f71261ecc4daf233c28dc377a95e1e0ac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ebd4853490d9e38968dbde7742872e6b7b7a7ec7.png[/img]


The map shows where the cameras are located.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/9c335bf706309a0e8c39d9d1498a575a034458e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0f6385a7740db9618028b16af284d553bff4bfb0.jpg[/img]

Remember, the cameras are not indestructible. When you see the red camera symbol on the map, it means that it is damaged. It can transmit the picture, but it can be difficult to read. However, it is worth checking though as the cause (or rather the perpetrator) of the damaged camera may still be hanging around somewhere and keep on rampaging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d2e0e0926b2b1adcb613a46d13bd79577d99277b.jpg[/img]

Is the camera glaring? Certainly this convict's fault! Report him as soon as possible and he will do more damage after him!

notes.title: Update#2 - Daily routines in Prison Simulator
notes.content:
HI, 
It’s been some time since you heard from us, but now we're sending you some new screenshots from our Prison Simulator. I know you're getting impatient and keep asking us about the release date, but we still don’t know it. At the moment, we are polishing the game, so that it would satisfy you and give you a better gaming experience. 

During your daily routines you can sometimes be tasked with observing the prison yard. Our duty, of course, is to keep everything in order, and it is a well-known issue that the community of prisoners include the rebellious ones as well. Here, we’ve just enter the yard, the sun is shining, and it seems to be quite peaceful so far.far. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e9eb6098fcdd789352ad0c021d198169948c254b.png[/img]

Remember though that the prison yard is being observed not just by a single guard because there are more than two of them as we’ve got another one watching us from the tower. But wait... This cop. You know... He doesn’t fancy being disturbed at work. Prisoners, don’t mess around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a7f9f5294e9000b53b6f8576948a97fa36873636.png[/img]

Another shot from the game is checking if everything is OK. Now, we are in the cell block. For now, it seems to be alright because the prisoners are in their cells, but well... We don’t know what they’re up to. You can always search them...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8c54d20bc12bbae1420e1b7d887eb1f7158b4795.png[/img]

We are also working on... here you can see a way which leads to the execution chamber. Are you ready? You know... to execute a prisoner? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c90cb6a6fee2a2a1d82bf9cfa6d0dd6a449af471.png[/img]
